reviewItem.question: Does "Cilium could previously be run in a configuration where the Etcd instances that distribute Cilium state between nodes would be managed in pod network by Cilium…" mean a change to product-relationship:cilium|name=etcd (removed)?

proposed.statement: Support for running Cilium's Etcd instances in the pod network managed by Cilium itself (previously deprecated) has been removed; alternatives are documented in k8s_install_etcd.
